scope: Two distinct GPU hosts; genuine pre-existing holder GPU prefix KV; holder performs native HF batch-suffix decoding and streams token IDs plus diagnostic logits.
comparison_rule: abs(candidate - reference) <= atol + rtol * abs(reference), for every vocabulary logit at every generated token

float32.primary_reference: Both full-context native HF recomputation and independent local cached-prefix plus batch-suffix native HF execution.
float32.token_acceptance: Every original pairwise comparison must have identical greedy token IDs and pass the fixed all-vocabulary tolerances.
float32.backend_policy: Eager attention, CUDA matmul TF32 off, cuDNN TF32 off, highest float32 matmul precision. Existing FP32 reduction flags are recorded without changing them.

bfloat16.primary_reference: Independent local native HF cached prefix followed by the complete suffix in one batch, then single-token greedy decoding; this matches holder execution granularity.
bfloat16.token_acceptance: All holder greedy token IDs must equal the local cached-prefix/batch-suffix reference and all vocabulary logits must pass the same fixed 1e-4 tolerances.
bfloat16.chunking_diagnostic: Full-context recomputation is still executed, and its complete pairwise errors, finite status and token equality are retained. Differences arising from full-context versus cached-prefix/batch-suffix execution are not promoted into a new tolerance or hidden from the report.
bfloat16.backend_policy: BF16 model and KV, eager attention, TF32 off, highest float32 matmul precision; FP16 and BF16 reduced-precision matmul reductions disabled and recorded.
bfloat16.rule_selection: The dtype selects the acceptance rule before model execution or any comparison; no runtime fallback based on observed errors.

shared_requirements: Load only staged model files and verify every file against the frozen model manifest.
Require distinct hostnames and equality of model-manifest SHA256, source/protocol SHA256, requested dtype and actual backend flags across both ranks.
Record actual floating model parameter dtypes, buffer dtypes, every audited forward's KV dtypes and native logits dtype.
Require actual floating model parameter dtype and actual KV dtype to match the requested precision.
Construct and keep holder prefix on GPU before the request barrier; receive the actual suffix token tensor after that barrier.
Keep zero KV tensor transfer, existing prefix integrity/audit checks, and the no-prefix-recomputation execution audit.
Generate the fixed token count greedily, without EOS early exit.
Transmit token IDs as int64 and diagnostic logits as float32 in both precision modes. Conversion for diagnostics does not change the model or KV computation dtype.
Report token-payload bytes separately from diagnostic-logit bytes; these correctness runs are not performance evidence.
Retain every full, local and holder comparison and each token sequence, including diagnostic failures.
not_claimed: BF16 full-context and split-context executions are numerically identical.
These three small-model correctness cases establish A800 or large-model serving performance.
Holder-side decode alone validates progressive repair, multiple-request isolation, or cancellation cleanup.
